name: Mid-term TermDefined PTC net multiply
decisiveFact: On a FRESH v67.0 Force-reprice of active V21 (ESDV 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY) on 2026-06-30, the CLEAN list-priced TermDefined mid-term line 0QLWC000002LCwH4AW (Qty3, List250, PTC=0.7397260273972603 exact 270/365, TotalAdjustmentAmount=0) comes out NetTotalPrice=750 AND TotalLineAmount=750 -- BOTH full, not the prorated 250*3*0.7397=554.79. The defect is present on EITHER field, so the main verifier's 'wrong field measured (TermDefined writes TotalLineAmount)' rebuttal is false: TotalLineAmount is also full (750). Two further clean lines confirm: 0QLWC000002SYdV4AW (PTC=0.9616, adj=0) NetTot=250 TotLineAmt=250 (expected 240.41); 0QLWC0000034VbN4AU (PTC=0.9151, adj=0) NetTot=3465 TotLineAmt=3465 (expected 3170.71). Only the DISCOUNTED line 0QLWC0000034VY94AM (PTC=0.9151, TotalAdjustmentAmount=-2266.23) prorates (TotLineAmt=3170.71=3465*0.9151), and it does so STABLY across reprices -- so the 'identical sibling => non-deterministic/stale' rebuttal is also false: the pair differ by a discount/adjustment path (-2266.23 vs 0), not randomness.

V21 body Data/pricing-v21-validation/proc_retrieve/unpackaged/expressionSetDefinition/Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition: SubscriptionPricing95 @116850 parentStep=ListContainer93, gated by ListOperation94 (SellingModelType IN ('TermDefined','Evergreen')); the Evergreen leg (SubscriptionPricing @~116692) multiplies NetUnitPrice*Qty*PTC -> ItemNetTotalPrice + NetUnitPrice (true net proration), but the TermDefined path writes only TotalLineAmount via ProrationMultiplier and that write does NOT fire (stays full) for clean adjustment=0 list-priced lines; NetTotalPrice=IF(ItemNetTotalPrice>0,ItemNetTotalPrice,TotalLineAmount) so NetTotalPrice never reflects PTC for clean TermDefined lines. defectStep: SubscriptionPricing95 (parentStep ListContainer93, filter ListOperation94 SellingModelType IN ('TermDefined','Evergreen')) -- the TermDefined ProrationMultiplier(=PricingTermCount) net-proration multiply does not apply to clean list-priced TermDefined mid-term lines: both TotalLineAmount and NetTotalPrice come out full (750, 250, 3465). Net-proration parity with the Evergreen leg (SubscriptionPricing -> ItemNetTotalPrice/NetUnitPrice) is missing for TermDefined; PTC is derived correctly (native, fractional, exact) but never multiplied into the net for non-discounted lines.
reason: AUDIT is correct, MAIN verifier refuted on live ground truth. All three pillars of the BLOCKED/TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT rebuttal fail against a fresh reprice: (1) 'wrong field -- TermDefined writes TotalLineAmount' -- FALSE: on the clean defect line TotalLineAmount is ALSO full (750), so the over-bill holds on either field; (2) 'cited 3170.71 is stale' -- FALSE: after fresh Force-reprice 0034VY94AM TotLineAmt=3170.71 is STABLE, it does not refresh away; (3) 'identical siblings price differently => non-deterministic' -- FALSE: 0034VY94AM (adj=-2266.23, Non-Production discount) and 0034VbN4AU (adj=0) are NOT identical and both results are stable/deterministic across reprices. The true behavior: V21 prorates only TermDefined lines that carry a discount/adjustment path; clean list-priced mid-term TermDefined lines are charged the FULL annual amount despite a correctly-derived fractional PTC. This meets the FAIL bar in full: (a) inputs provably valid -- real UI-built TermDefined Anniversary lines, active PBE list 250/3465 USD, parent book active, fractional PTC exact to day-count/365, not headless $0; (b) intended branch provably fired -- SellingModelType=TermDefined satisfies ListOperation94 feeding SubscriptionPricing95 and PTC is present/fractional; (c) current active V21 produces the wrong number on a FRESH re-measure of CLEAN lines (750/250/3465 vs 554.79/240.41/3170.71), stable across repeated reprices. Positive control PTC=1 (5900) prices correctly, isolating the fault to the fractional-PTC net-apply for clean TermDefined lines. This is a genuine over-bill PROCEDURE-DEFECT consistent with SC-3420/SC-3411 provenance: the PTC derivation half was restored but the TermDefined net-proration apply leg was not restored for non-discounted lines.
